name: AGC 739005 (Hubble)
blurb: AGC 739005, a gas-rich dwarf galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: agc739005-hubble
story: A faint, gas-rich dwarf galaxy discovered by its hydrogen gas, sharing its corner of space with a neighbor galaxy within 500 kpc. Hubble resolved its brightest red giant stars to measure how far away it is.

claims.text: AGC 739005 is a SHIELD II target of Hubble program 13750, 'Fundamental Parameters of the SHIELD II Galaxies'
SHIELD galaxies are gas-rich dwarf galaxies
SHIELD galaxies were selected from the ALFALFA radio (HI) survey catalog
The Hubble imaging was used to measure distances from the tip of the red giant branch
A TRGB distance was measured for AGC 739005
AGC 739005 has a neighbor galaxy (D564-08) within 500 kpc
